annotation_method: Provisional visual point annotations by Codex during implementation, before inspecting the release result; not independently verified human ground truth.
coordinate_system: displayed original 1280x720 pixels; player points approximate midpoint of lowest visible feet
null_semantics: ball location not reliably visible; excluded, not a negative label
limitations: Same venue and source recording across the temporal split. No domain-general accuracy, bounce precision, or court accuracy claim is justified. Independent human verification and private-camera validation remain required.
